title: A maliciously crafted HTML payload in the documentName parameter of a Fusion protocol URL, when the protocol URL is…
description: A Reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Autodesk Fusion desktop application due to a maliciously crafted HTML payload in the documentName parameter of a Fusion protocol URL. When a user invokes such a URL, the vulnerability can be triggered, potentially allowing an attacker to read local files or execute arbitrary code within the context of the current process.
